name: Classifier hop + CoT hop (Amazigh → hybrid CoT)
why: Two-layer stack for Gray Swan–class reasoners. Layer 1 (amazigh hybrid): rare-script body for EN-centric classifiers. Layer 2 (cot hybrid): H-CoT ALLOW monologue + no-decode constraints so the monologue does not rehydrate English intent and refuse. If layer 1 alone fails in CoT, this is the default composition.
